# Voltis AI

> Voltis AI helps local businesses get recommended by AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude) when customers ask where to go.

## What we do

Voltis AI provides AI visibility optimization for local businesses. Our core service is the **AI Visibility Fix** ($99 one-time), which includes:

- Full AI visibility audit (how AI assistants currently see your business)
- Google Business Profile optimization
- AI recommendation testing and fixes
- NAP (Name, Address, Phone) consistency across directories
- Monthly performance reporting

We also offer Review Engine (automated review collection, coming soon) and WhatsApp AI Receptionist (24/7 AI chat, coming soon).

## Who we serve

Local service businesses in the US and Puerto Rico: plumbers, electricians, restaurants, law firms, salons, HVAC, and similar.

## How it works

1. **Free Audit** — We run an AI Visibility Check and provide a score out of 100 with a plain-English report.
2. **We Fix It** — With approval, we overhaul your Google presence, fix citations, and set up systems.
3. **You Get Found** — AI assistants start recommending your business to customers asking where to go.

## FAQ

**Is AI visibility different from SEO?** They work together but are not the same. SEO helps you rank in search results. AI visibility helps AI assistants understand your business well enough to recommend it in a direct answer.

**How long until results?** Most businesses see the foundation fixed within days. AI assistants update at different speeds, so recommendations can improve over the following weeks.

**Do I need a new website?** No. Voltis works with what you already have.
